head: 2a923be5a0348c8f6e80a1af5df3b94301667231
claim: An installed Claude account's status probe keeps the person's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, so a Claude account pinned to its own config folder no longer reads signed out; the billing and provider overrides stay removed.

steps.start: An app uses an installed Claude account pinned to a config directory; the fixture CLI records the actual status-probe environment.
steps: Run the existing status-probe integration proof against parent cli.ts in an isolated scratch copy; observe the missing CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR assertion fail.
Run the same proof against the committed fixed source; observe the account ready and the probe environment retain CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR while ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN stay absent.
Capture the fix diff, FIX changelog fragment, prior sealed run, and passing full-suite summary.
steps.result: The proof fails before the fix (exit 1) and passes after (exit 0); the installed account status probe retains its config folder and removes billing overrides.

verdicts.seen: I read the capture's entries: one BEFORE run (fails, actual undefined against the pinned CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) and one AFTER run on the fixed cli.ts. The AFTER run shows '✔ installed Claude status probe keeps the person's CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR while the billing overrides stay unset', with 'pass 1', 'fail 0', and 'EXIT: 0'. The test asserts status.env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR equals the pinned folder and that ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN are absent from the env, which matches the outcome. The capture is a single-part proof, so no parts are listed.
